class.name: VCSVParseResult
class.brief_description:
Structured parse outcome: success, error code, message, line/column, warnings, table.
结构化解析结果：成功、错误码、消息、行列、警告、表。
class.description:
Returned by [VCSVParser]. On success, [member table] holds the parsed grid and [member error] is [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. On failure, [member success] is [code]false[/code], [member error] is a non-OK code and [member message] / [member error_line] / [member error_column] locate the problem. Non-fatal issues (lenient row padding, etc.) are collected in [member warnings].
由 [VCSVParser] 返回。成功时 [member table] 保存解析后的网格，[member error] 为 [constant @GlobalScope.OK]。失败时 [member success] 为 [code]false[/code]，[member error] 为非 OK 码，[member message] / [member error_line] / [member error_column] 定位问题。非致命问题（宽松补齐等）收集在 [member warnings]。

method.name: ok
method.description:
Alias for [member success].
[member success] 的别名。

method.name: as_text
method.description:
Human-readable one-line summary.
人类可读的单行摘要。

members.member:
Whether the parse succeeded.
解析是否成功。

Error description (empty on success).
错误描述（成功时为空）。

1-based error line (0 = none).
1 起始的错误行（0 = 无）。

1-based error column (0 = none).
1 起始的错误列（0 = 无）。

The parsed table (null on failure).
解析后的表（失败时为 null）。
